{{Quote|The general is entirely misinformed, your imminence! A few coats of paint and I'll be ready for the Lunar Gala!|C2-D4|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Lunar Gala''' was an event that the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C2-D4]] attended while in the service of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. When C2-D4 was damaged in battle with the [[Order of Revan]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], his memory banks were scrambled and he believed himself to be preparing for the Gala.
